preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Mix ingredients, except NaHCO3, L-cysteine·HCl·H2O and Na2S·9H2O, and
    adjust pH to 6.5.
- step_number: 2
  action: HEAT
  description: Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec, then, cool down under a stream of H2-CO2
    (80:20, v/v) and add NaHCO3 to the medium.
- step_number: 3
  action: ALIQUOT
  description: Dispense the medium into suitable culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the
    medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) and seal
    with butyl rubber stoppers.
- step_number: 4
  action: STORE
  description: After autoclaving, stand the medium overnight.
- step_number: 5
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O as 5% solutions, respectively,
    under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 6
  action: MIX
  description: Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the L-cysteine·HCl·H2O
    and Na2S·9H2O solutions.
